description: Reorder or remove an app's existing store-listing screenshots for one language. Preserves the listing's title/descriptions untouched. Can ONLY reorder/remove already-uploaded screenshots (matched by URL) — cannot add a brand-new screenshot image.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for the listing, e.g. en-US.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

screenshot_urls.description: JSON array of the EXISTING screenshot URLs, in the desired final order (omit a URL to remove that screenshot). Every URL must already be present in the listing — this tool cannot add new images.

store_listing_id.description: Numeric store listing id from the Play Console store listing URL (0 for the main listing).

name: update_store_listing_screenshots
